title: Job
description: The Hebrew Bible's wisdom-literature dialogue on theodicy and divine justice. Cited in the corpus principally for the prologue (Job 1–2) — the heavenly-court scenes in which the satan figure appears as Yahweh's adversarial-prosecutor — and for the whirlwind speeches' cosmological imagery.
